carry.title: Carry with Tracecart
carry.lead: Trucking companies, freight forwarders and couriers: carry goods for Tracecart's customers on the routes you already run. Apply, show your papers, and a person reviews your application.
carry.step1: Tell us about your company, the modes you run and the countries you serve, and add your documents.
carry.step2: A person at Tracecart checks them, and approves you or tells you what's missing.
carry.step3: Once approved, add your routes and rates in the console. We send you the shipments your routes fit, and ask your price for freight.
carry.account: Apply with the account you'll use for work: once approved, it becomes your carrier account. You can still shop with it.
carry.gateLead: Sign in or create an account to start your application.

explain.DRAFT: Add your documents, then send your application.
explain.SUBMITTED: A person at Tracecart is checking your application. We'll email you.
explain.NEEDS_CHANGES: We need something more: see the note below, change what's asked, and send it again.
explain.APPROVED: You carry for Tracecart. Add your routes and rates, and answer quote requests.
explain.REJECTED: We can't go ahead with your application. The note below says why.
explain.SUSPENDED: Your carrier account is suspended and your routes are switched off. The note below says why.

reviewedDetails: Your name, country and tax number were reviewed: ask us to change them.
name: Company name
fleetHint: For example: three 20-tonne trucks, two vans

admin.title: Carrier applications
admin.lead: Companies that applied to carry for Tracecart. Accept each required document, then approve: the account becomes a carrier account.
admin.requiredHint: What a carrier must provide before it can be approved. Changing this is recorded.
admin.ownApplication: This is your own application: someone else has to decide it.
admin.approveHint: Approving makes this account a carrier account for this company. It keeps its customer access.
admin.suspendHint: Switches off the carrier's active routes at once. Reinstating brings them back.
admin.reinstateHint: The routes suspension switched off come back on.

quotes.title: Quote requests
quotes.lead: Tracecart asks your price to move a customer's goods. You see the goods and the two cities; give what you charge us.
quotes.packagesWeight: {count, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}}, {kg} kg
quotes.acceptingOff: New quote requests are paused. Your routes still run.
quotes.chosen: Your price was chosen: the shipment is in your deliveries.
quotes.answerHint: What you charge Tracecart for this move, door to door as described. The customer never sees it.
